summary.text:
LG INR21700 M50, 3x WLTC 3b (C-segment EV, 96s35p), ambient 35 degC
Limits: T_peak <= 45 degC, in-cell dT <= 5 degC, ready again within 180 min
39 designs, 24 feasible, 4 on the trade-off front
NOTE: bottom plates are solved in 2D (radius x height). A chiller pulling a hot-soaked pack down through its base opens large top-to-bottom gradients while it does so.
NOTE: liquid pump power covers the whole loop (7.9 mW/cell at most) and the radiator fan is charged at 3 % of the heat it rejects; chiller idle losses are not included.
Lightest       air 0.15 g/s, no filler: T_peak 35.3 degC, +1.8% mass, aux 0.82% of energy, recovery 0 min
Lowest energy  bottom 0.02 g/s, RT42: T_peak 35.4 degC, +18.2% mass, aux 0.03% of energy, recovery 0 min
Balanced       ribbon 0.02 g/s, 3.5 mm gap, no filler: T_peak 35.3 degC, +7.2% mass, aux 0.04% of energy, recovery 0 min
Not picked     sealed (no cooling), RT42: +10.0% mass, aux 0.00%, but fails (slow) at worst-case R0 = 43 mOhm (peak 36.5 degC)
